problem: Agent research was fragmented: external GitHub and OSS signals could be discovered, but there was no durable loop for primary-source verification, deterministic scoring, sandbox prioritization, evidence retention, and repeated discovery.

evidence.ref: PR #13 verification: capability scoring regression 5/5 PASS
GitHub Actions run 34097663727: Capability Acquisition Loop completed success, including external signal scan
GitHub Actions run 34097663653: Verify Hub completed success

capability_gain: External capability discovery became a repeatable evidence-driven loop: GitHub Search + GitGem + seed tracking feed deterministic scoring, rolling freshness, sandbox queues, KEEP/KILL decisions, and durable JSON evidence instead of ad-hoc chat-only research.
reusable_pattern: Separate discovery from adoption. Automate signal intake and scoring, but prohibit automatic third-party installation. Require primary-source verification, license/security review, isolated proof-of-work, objective evidence, and KEEP/KILL before project connection. Persist evidence outside ephemeral CI retention.

risks.license: The loop itself does not grant license rights to discovered repositories; every third-party candidate remains individually license-gated before adoption.
risks.security: Automatic third-party installation is intentionally prohibited; sandbox and dependency/security review precede production use.
risks.operational: Discovery quality depends on upstream GitHub/GitGem availability and scoring calibration; stale or noisy signals require periodic regression review.

agent_lab_value.reason: This is a reusable operating pattern for turning public OSS discovery into verified capability acquisition without letting popularity metrics or agent self-report become adoption evidence.
